features.title: Dynamic request.* calls are available by default in v6
features.frontend_notes: PineLanguageProfile models the default; openpine.requests.v1 marks dynamic enablement, local scope use, and whether runtime/backtest must execute a dynamic request.

features.title: bool values cannot be na in v6
features.frontend_notes: Semantic diagnostics reject bool targets initialized from na under the v6 profile.

features.title: int/float are not implicitly cast to bool in v6
features.frontend_notes: Condition checks use profile-specific bool rules.

features.title: and/or evaluate lazily
features.frontend_notes: The frontend validates bool operands; exact short-circuit evaluation belongs to runtime lowering.

features.title: const int division can return fractional values
features.frontend_notes: PineInferenceEngine and analyzer variable checks treat const-int division as float under the v6 profile while preserving v5 compatibility.

features.title: when parameter removed from applicable strategy.* calls
features.frontend_notes: Version-gated signature resolver emits P2A1501 for removed strategy when parameters.

features.title: Function calls cannot include more than one argument for the same parameter
features.frontend_notes: Signature binding plus legacy call validation reports duplicate named/positional bindings.

features.title: request.footprint(), footprint and volume_row types
features.frontend_notes: The registry carries parse/signature names where present; execution is runtime/data-provider work.

features.title: Triple-quoted multiline strings
features.frontend_notes: Lexer/parser accept multiline string literals; semantic treatment is string-compatible.

features.title: array.sort, array.sort_indices and matrix.sort support UDT IDs with sort_field
features.frontend_notes: Requires collection/UDT field-aware semantic validation in the future post-4.0 slice.

features.title: Line wrapping inside parentheses may use any indentation
features.frontend_notes: Layout layer accepts parenthesized wrapping; extra golden cases remain needed.

features.title: Libraries can export const variables
features.frontend_notes: Stage 1 fixed pure builtin const propagation for exported const initializers such as math.sqrt(const).

features.title: time_close/time_close() behavior on tick and price-based charts
features.frontend_notes: Parser can represent history/calls; exact availability is chart/runtime dependent.

features.title: for loop end boundary is evaluated dynamically before each iteration
features.frontend_notes: Frontend preserves the AST; runtime lowering/backtest must honor dynamic boundary updates.

features.title: bid and ask built-in variables
features.frontend_notes: Registry/profile recognizes the variables; timeframe-specific na behavior is runtime/data-provider logic.

features.title: The previous 550-scope limit is removed
features.frontend_notes: Frontend no longer assumes a TradingView scope cap; resource ceilings remain OpenPine policy.
